discoveries.line: test/bin-scaffold.test.js's 'list reaches its stub branch' assertion now fails because a sibling, already-landed scope implemented cmdList for real — pre-existing conflict between the scaffold test and that sibling scope's work, outside this scope's substrate and unrelated to the done command.

assumptions: lib/parse-index.js and bin/todo.js are shared_substrate with sibling scopes (add-todo, list-todo, remove-todo) also running concurrently; found cmdAdd, cmdList and cmdRm already implemented mid-edit by other in-flight workers and reconciled by adding only the cmdDone branch and the shared require line, touching no other handler.

lib/parse-index.js already existed with a MissingIndexError that also caught raw === '' (empty string); this scope's AC explicitly requires `done ""` to be E_INVALID_INDEX, not E_MISSING_INDEX, so narrowed the missing-check to `undefined`/`null` only, letting '' fall through to the strict integer regex and come out E_INVALID_INDEX — matches this scope's AC without changing behavior for the true missing-argument case other commands rely on.
Error message format `Error: <CODE> - <message>` to stderr for parse-index errors, matching the format already used by the sibling `rm` handler for the same error classes.

Store items seeded directly via fs.writeFileSync/JSON in tests (not through `todo add`) since the `add` command's implementation is outside this scope's task and its landed state at test-run time isn't something this scope should depend on.
